meta.dataset: Refinery Capacity Report (Form EIA-820, "Annual Refinery Report"), refinery capacity data by individual refinery as of January 1, 2026; coordinates from EIA map layer "U.S. Petroleum Refineries" (Petroleum_Refineries_US_2021 shapefile)
meta.capacityField: QUANTITY where PRODUCT = 'TOTAL OPERABLE CAPACITY' and SUPPLY = 'Atmospheric Crude Distillation Capacity (barrels per calendar day)'
meta.license: Public domain. EIA: "U.S. government publications are in the public domain and are not subject to copyright protection." (https://www.eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php). Shapefile metadata use constraint: "None (public use)"; "The U.S. Energy Information Administration gives no warranty, expressed or implied, as to the accuracy, reliability, or completeness of these data."
meta.notes: The EIA U.S. Energy Atlas ArcGIS layer Petroleum_Refineries_US_EIA (https://services7.arcgis.com/FGr1D95XCGALKXqM/arcgis/rest/services/Petroleum_Refineries_US_EIA/FeatureServer) returned 'Token Required' at retrieval time, so it could not be used. Instead: name/company/corporation/state/PADD/capacity come from the EIA Refinery Capacity Report workbook (as of January 1, 2026); lat/lon come from the EIA shapefile published on eia.gov (as of January 1, 2021; its own capacity fields are in barrels per STREAM day and are NOT used). The two EIA files were joined by state + site (+ company or corporation), comparing names case-insensitively and ignoring spaces/punctuation; 'coordMatch' records which key matched and 'coordSourceCompany' the 2021 company name, so ownership/name changes are visible. 'name' and 'city' are both the EIA SITE field (EIA names sites by city). capacityBpd is null where the workbook has no TOTAL OPERABLE CAPACITY row for the site (sites with downstream units only). Refineries in the 2026 report with no unambiguous 2021 coordinate match are listed in 'unmatchedNoCoordinates' and are NOT in 'facilities'. 2021 shapefile sites absent from the 2026 report are listed in 'inCoordinateFileButNotIn2026Report'.
